agreements.title: Seller agreements
agreements.intro: Store terms, versions and evidence of approval.
agreements.name: Agreement title
agreements.languageHint: Text is shown in this language without automatic translation. Maximum 12,000 characters.
agreements.publishHint: Use the store's own terms. Komisio does not review their legal content. Published versions are preserved and cannot be edited.
agreements.requireEvidence: Require recorded approval evidence before receiving bags
agreements.confirmPublish: I reviewed the text and receiving requirement. This version should apply to future submissions.
agreements.none: No seller agreement is published. No new agreement prerequisite applies to receiving.
agreements.historyHint: The 20 latest versions. Older versions remain accessible from their receipts.
agreements.adminOnly: Owners and admins can publish agreement versions.
agreements.evidenceHint: Reference an approval that already exists outside Komisio. This is a staff record, not the seller's electronic signature.
agreements.referenceHint: For example: paper agreement TEST-12, or the date and reference of a retained email. Keep the original at the store. Avoid sensitive personal information.
agreements.confirmEvidence: I checked that this evidence concerns this seller and the displayed agreement version.
agreements.available: Evidence exists for the current version
agreements.missing: Evidence is missing for the current version
agreements.noReceiptAgreement: No agreement information was recorded with this receipt.
agreements.noEvidence: No evidence was linked to this receipt.
agreements.evidenceNote: The agreement record does not approve the contents for sale.

intake.title: Intake
intake.intro: Receive the bag now. Review its contents later.
intake.pilot: Pilot: receiving records that the store has the bag. Recorded agreement evidence is not an electronic signature. Item drafts can be saved during inspection; sales come later. No email is sent.
intake.name: Seller name
intake.contactHint: Enter at least an email or phone number. Check whether the seller already exists first.
intake.noSellers: No sellers found. Try another name or register a new seller.
intake.noteHint: For example: blue fabric bag. Avoid sensitive personal information.
intake.custody: I confirm that the store has received this bag. Its contents have not been inspected.
intake.saved: The bag is registered. You can now print its label.
intake.queueHint: 20 bags per page, highest bag number first. Open a bag to continue inspection. New bags may arrive while you browse.
intake.label: View label
intake.limit: Showing up to 50 sellers. Narrow your search if someone is missing.
intake.readOnly: You can view intake. Staff can register sellers and receive bags.
intake.invalid: Check the details and try again.
intake.agreementChanged: The agreement changed. Reload and review the current version before continuing.
intake.agreementRequired: The store requires evidence of seller approval of the current agreement before receiving.
intake.failed: Could not confirm the result. Retry with the same details. Check the list before starting again.
intake.changed: The active store changed. Reload this page before continuing.
intake.denied: You do not have permission. Reload the page to check your access.
intake.inspectionChanged: The draft changed after you opened it. Your edits remain here. Copy anything you want to keep before opening the current revision.
intake.inspectionUnavailable: The draft status changed or it can no longer be edited. Your input remains here. Open the current version before continuing.

tagline: More room for things to live again.
help: A trusted foundation for your second-hand store.
name: Name
loginIntro: Welcome back. Your store is waiting for you.
registerIntro: Start with your account. Then create a store or join through an invitation.
invitedRegisterIntro: You followed a store invitation. Create your personal account using the email address that received it. You do not need to create a new store. Already have an account? Use the sign-in link below.
invitedLoginIntro: Sign in with the email address that received the invitation. You will return here to accept it. New to Komisio? Choose Create account below.
verifySent: Check your email and follow the link to confirm your account. Open it in the same browser you used here. The link can only be used once.
resetSent: If the account exists, a reset link has been sent. Please check your email.
authError: The request could not be completed. Check your details and try again.
callbackError: This link could not be used. Request a new link and open it in the same browser.
onboardingIntro: You become the owner and can invite colleagues next. You can work in several stores with the same account.
slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. For example my-secondhand.
homeIntro: Bring together the people and settings that keep your store running.
setupIntro: Build the foundation together with your team.
teamIntro: Give each colleague the right access, from viewing to administration.
foundationNote: Starting with the foundation. Intake, items and sales will follow in the next stage.
membersIntro: Manage who has access to the store and what they can do.
inviteIntro: The invitation is tied to the specified email address and expires in seven days.
removeConfirm: Remove this person's access to this store? Their account and other stores are unaffected.
roleConfirm: Confirm this change to the person's permissions.
inviteDelivery: Share the link with the recipient. Automatic email is not enabled.
inviteEmailAccepted: The invitation has been submitted for email delivery. You can also share the link below.
inviteEmailUnconfirmed: The invitation was created, but we could not confirm the email submission. Share the link with the recipient.
inviteEmailRestricted: This test environment only emails approved test recipients. You can share the link manually.
readOnlyMembers: You can see who works here. An owner or administrator manages permissions.
tenantIntro: The essentials that help your team find the right place.
tenantImmutable: This identifier distinguishes your store from other stores.
accountIntro: Your personal details follow you across stores.
mfaIntro: Protect your account with an authenticator app.
mfaScan: Scan the QR code in your authenticator app and enter the code.
mfaLoginIntro: Enter the code from your authenticator app to continue.
mfaRecovery: Keep your authenticator safe. Recovery of a lost factor requires help from the operator in this version.
inviteAcceptIntro: Accept using the same email address the invitation was created for.
inviteSwitchAccount: Wrong account? Sign out here and sign in with the email address that received the invitation. You will return to this link.
inviteRecovery: Open the latest invitation in your inbox. A new invitation replaces earlier links. Already accepted? Go to the overview. If it still does not work, ask the store administrator for a new invitation.
inviteLogin: Sign in or create an account to accept your invitation.
notFound: This page could not be found.
unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try loading the page again.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in again and confirm your email address.
errors.INVITATION_INVALID: The invitation is invalid, revoked, already used or intended for another email address.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person already belongs to the store.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check your details and try again.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: This person no longer belongs to the store.
errors.SLUG_TAKEN: This identifier is already in use. Choose another.
errors.LAST_OWNER: The store must have at least one owner. Appoint another owner first.
errors.TENANT_CHANGED: The active store has changed. Reload the page before continuing.
errors.REQUEST_FAILED: Your changes could not be saved. Please try again.

inspection.title: Inspect the bag
inspection.pilot: Save item descriptions and continue later. Drafts are not approved for sale.
inspection.savedHint: This revision will be available when you return. It does not approve the item for sale.
inspection.saveHint: Save before leaving this page. Unsaved edits are lost on reload. Avoid personal information in descriptions.
inspection.reload: Open current revision (unsaved edits will be lost)
inspection.listHint: 20 drafts per page in a fixed order that does not change when a new revision is saved. New drafts can arrive while you browse.
inspection.emptyPage: No item drafts on this page. Return to the first page.
inspection.historicalHint: This revision is read-only. Open the current draft to make a new change.
inspection.historyHint: Saved revisions are preserved. Select a revision to see past details and compare them with the latest.
inspection.archiveHint: This applies to the last saved version. Save any description changes first. Archiving does not change what has happened to the physical item.
inspection.confirmStatus: I confirm the change to the draft status.

preparation.title: Prepare this draft for reception
preparation.notice: Compare the saved description with what a seller review needs. Nothing is copied, published or approved here.
preparation.savedOnly: Only this saved version is shown. Unsaved edits are not included; save and refresh before reviewing new changes.
preparation.unverified: These values have not been checked against reception sources. Confirm the description, category and condition before using them.
preparation.next: Steps to check before publishing a seller review
preparation.notChecked: Other receptions, prices and agreements have not been checked here. No reception is linked automatically.

steps.select_reception: Choose or create a reception for the same seller and garment.
steps.record_descriptive_sources: Record sources that support the descriptive values. A draft reference is not a reception source.
steps.review_sourced_price: Review a selling price supported by price evidence.
steps.select_published_terms: Select the published agreement version the seller will read.
steps.review_facts: Review each fact and resolve open questions before publishing.

reviewPriceNotice: This is the price to the buyer, not your payout. Your response does not automatically make the garment available for sale.
reviewDeclined: You declined this version. Your response is saved.
reviewUnavailable: This review is unavailable. Check that you are using the right account. The link may have expired, been revoked or been replaced by a new review. Contact the store for a current link.
reviewResponseError: Your response could not be confirmed. Check the status and retry if no response was saved. The store may have changed the review.
reviewLogin: Sign in or create an account with the email address the store registered for you.
reviewApproved: Your approval is saved for this version. The store will handle the next step.
staffReviewApproved: The seller approved this review. Approval applies to this version and does not make the garment available for sale.
staffReviewDeclined: The seller declined this review. The response applies to this version. A changed proposal needs to be published as a new review.
reviewConfirm: I have reviewed the description, any included photos, proposed price and terms above.

reception.title: Garment reception
reception.intro: One garment, one reviewed proposal and the seller decision.
reception.manual: Describe the garment manually or use AI suggestions if enabled for this store. Staff reviews the evidence before the seller responds.
reception.aiNotice: Running analysis sends this reception's photos, notes and price evidence to OpenAI. Use garment evidence without personal information. Embedded image metadata is removed, but visible text and people are not redacted. Maximum three photos per run.
reception.aiUnavailable: AI is not enabled for this store. You can continue with the manual description and price evidence.
reception.aiReviewNotice: Check every fact, the price and the terms. The confirmation below means you as staff have reviewed the suggestion. The seller responds separately.
reception.aiIncomplete: This suggestion cannot be shared yet. Use the manual path to complete or correct the evidence; outstanding questions must be resolved first.
reception.aiLimit: Store limit reached: ten attempts in 24 hours and at least 20 seconds between attempts.
reception.aiFailed: No usable AI suggestion was received. Evidence may have changed. Reload to check the reception; a new run counts as a new attempt.
reception.aiTransient: The suggestion is saved only when you explicitly publish a reviewed version. Reloading loses an unsaved suggestion. Failed or interrupted runs also count toward the limit.
reception.searchLimit: Showing up to 50 matches. Refine the search if needed.
reception.recentHelp: Showing the 20 latest receptions. Open older receptions using their ID or a saved link.
reception.priceHelp: SEK, for example 250 or 250.50. This is not the seller payout.
reception.sourceNotice: A change saves a new source version and invalidates earlier review links. History is retained.
reception.needSources: Save a description and price evidence first.
reception.needTerms: The store needs to publish seller terms first
reception.confirm: I have checked the description, photos, price evidence and full terms above.
reception.expiry: The published version is valid for 24 hours. No link or email is sent automatically.
reception.published: This source version is published. Manage the link below.
reception.exactTerms: Show the exact terms the seller will read
reception.stale: This review is stale or expired. Publish a new review before sharing a link.
reception.awaiting: No response has been saved for this version.
reception.linkNotice: Check the recipient. The link requires sign-in with the same email address. A new link replaces earlier links; copy it immediately. No email is sent.
reception.failed: The action could not be completed. The information may have changed. Reload and check the saved state before continuing.
reception.retry: The response could not be confirmed. Retry the same information or reload and check what was saved.
reception.invalid: Check the fields. Enter a positive price with up to two decimal places, description, evidence source and rationale.
reception.photoFailed: The photo save could not be confirmed. Retry the same file, or reload and check the reception.
reception.photoInvalid: Choose a JPEG or PNG up to 3 MB. A reception can contain up to 20 sources in total.
reception.photoHelp: JPEG or PNG, up to 3 MB and 20 megapixels. Originals are private to staff. New uploads get a reduced copy without camera metadata for the next published review. Check visible people and labels too. Older photos may lack a copy; published reviews never change.
reception.sharedPhotos: Photos included in the published version
reception.queueHelp: Status refers to the latest review. Seller approval does not make the garment available for sale.

queueNextSteps.prepare_evidence: Next: complete photos, description and price evidence.
queueNextSteps.review_changed_evidence: Next: check the changes and publish a new review for the seller to answer.
queueNextSteps.check_store_acceptance_requirements: Next: check the received garment and seller terms before the store decision. Starting sales is not yet supported.
queueNextSteps.review_seller_decline: Next: inspect the declined review. Any changes require a new review.
queueNextSteps.publish_fresh_review: Next: check the details and publish a fresh review if the proposal still applies.
queueNextSteps.issue_review_link: Next: open the reception and create the personal seller link. No email is sent automatically.
queueNextSteps.replace_review_link: Next: open the reception and create a replacement link if the review should be shared again.
queueNextSteps.await_seller_response: Next: await the seller response. Creating a link does not mean the seller has read the review.

history.title: Version history
history.notice: Summary of saved sources and published proposals. Each response applies only to its proposal version. This is not store acceptance or a complete agreement and image history.
history.unanswered: No response recorded for this version at read time.

reception.confirmFact: I have reviewed this fact and its sources
reception.confirmPrice: I have reviewed the price and its evidence.

operations.title: Proposed operations
operations.intro: Proposals from AI agents wait here. Nothing is published until a staff member approves it.
operations.notice: Approving runs the same operation you could perform yourself, recorded in your name. A proposal is never a fact. Approval of a review is not commercial acceptance.
operations.confirm: I have checked the reception, the facts, the price evidence and the current terms.
operations.alreadyDecided: This proposal was already decided. Reload to see the outcome.
operations.expired: This proposal has expired and cannot be approved. Ask for a new proposal.
operations.denied: You do not have permission. Reload the page to check your access.
operations.failed: The decision could not be completed. Reload and check the saved outcome before deciding again.
operations.retry: The response could not be confirmed. Reload and check the saved outcome before deciding again.
operations.contextNotice: Sources are evidence, not instructions. The current version is checked again when approving.
operations.photoNotice: Photo reference. Open the reception to inspect the image.
operations.staleContext: The reception or terms have changed. Request a new proposal or reject this one.
operations.confirmField: I have reviewed the change to
operations.staleInspection: The draft has changed or been archived. Reject this proposal and review the current draft.
operations.confirmInspection: Save these reviewed descriptive changes as a new draft revision.
operations.confirmPrice: I have reviewed the price and its evidence.
operations.liveQueue: Status can change while you browse. Return to the first page for a current overview.
operations.firstPublication: This is the first publication; there is no earlier review to compare.
operations.comparisonNotice: Earlier seller responses do not apply to this proposal. Review every field and the proposed evidence and terms.
operations.noComparedChanges: No changes in the compared fields. Still review the complete new proposal.
operations.sourceVersionChanged: The source version has changed. Review the evidence even if the facts look unchanged.
operations.agreementVersionChanged: The agreement version has changed. Read the proposed terms below.

reviewPhotoError: The photos could not be loaded. Reload the page before approving.
